texto: In a Dutch letter («menukaart»), the main and inbound dishes are usually combined with adjectives or supplements: «tomatensoep» (tomato soup), «broodje kaas» (cheese sandwich, where «broodje» is the tiny bread), «groene salade» (green salad). The drinks section («dranken») contains the most common consumptions such as coffee, tea and water.

frases.nl: Dranken: water, thee en koffie: 2 euro.
frases.es: Bebidas: agua, té y café: 2 euros.
frases.en: Drinks: water, tea and coffee: 2 euros.
